svg.title: China 中国 + Central Asia 2027 draft route: Beijing → Yangtze delta → Xi'an → Silk Road → Xinjiang → far north → northern Xinjiang → Kazakhstan → Kyrgyzstan → Pamir → Uzbekistan

g.text: Mar – Apr: north China + Yangtze delta
May: Silk Road 河西走廊 + southern Xinjiang 南疆
late May – Jun: grasslands of the far north
Jun – Jul: northern Xinjiang 北疆, driest in summer

svg.text: ✈ home to Seattle, Day 172
China 中国 + Central Asia 2027 (draft): follow the weather
Day 1 = Tue 23 Mar 2027 (arrival in Beijing) · ✈ home from Tashkent ≈ Day 172 · ◆ = land border crossing · faded = optional
How each leg is travelled
Flight
Train (mostly high-speed)
Bus / shared taxi
4×4 (Pamir Highway)
Land border crossing
Flights: Seattle → Beijing, Kashgar → Hailar
(via Beijing or Urumqi), Arxan → Urumqi,
Tashkent → Seattle. Everything else by train,
bus, shared taxi or 4×4.
China visa stays: Day 1 → 58 and Day 64 → 118.
Kazakhstan: QazETA needed from 1 July 2027.
Pamir: GBAO permit ($20, fixed entry date).
Tashkurgan: border-area permit, in person,
at the police exit-entry office in Kashgar.
Weather: 10-year normals (Open-Meteo for China,
NASA POWER for Central Asia).
Route order and stop lengths only;
beds and legs come next.
